claim_policy: Only claims listed as passed in the paper claim audit are treated as measured. Open reproduction gates are executable reviewer tasks, not paper results.

measured_claims.boundary: Offline action-imitation result; not ACT/Diffusion or physical rollout success.
measured_claims.claim: ArmnetBench random split leaks lineages and offline BC drops under scene-disjoint split.

measured_claims.boundary: One LeRobot trace and one MuJoCo replay adapter; Isaac is not claimed tested.
measured_claims.claim: Timestamp-aware LeRobot replay reduces joint RMSE and tested MuJoCo replay error.

measured_claims.boundary: Two five-episode batch audits; not full LeRobot coverage.
measured_claims.claim: Two public LeRobotDataset batches round-trip exactly through WorldEpisode.

measured_claims.boundary: Pilot projection score, not a universal storage-format ranking.
measured_claims.claim: Seven pilot bindings preserve 17--39% natively outside the reference binding, with sidecars recovering dataset/log/world projections.

measured_claims.boundary: Injected and hand-authored fixtures; natural prevalence remains open.
measured_claims.claim: Validator detects all injected fault classes and independent fixture failures.

measured_claims.boundary: Scoped natural-source corpus, not maintainer-confirmed prevalence.
measured_claims.claim: Pilot natural-source corpus records 19 cases across five public robot-learning datasets.

measured_claims.boundary: Deterministic pilots, not production game or AV dataset results.
measured_claims.claim: Two deterministic non-robotics USS pilots demonstrate collision-patch and clock-domain drift.

measured_claims.boundary: Controlled proxy; not a hardware or RoboSnap/DROID-Sim rerun.
measured_claims.claim: Controlled real-to-sim contract drift ablations fail under drifted contracts and recover with WorldEpisode.

measured_claims.boundary: Catalog-side evidence only; does not materialize a billion rows or payload bytes.
measured_claims.claim: Generated catalog benchmark describes a billion-episode-capacity sharded corpus.

measured_claims.boundary: Source-level call-out audit; no published-score inflation claim.
measured_claims.claim: Famous benchmark audit is fail-closed and makes zero inflation claims in this draft.

measured_claims.boundary: Open gates are unclaimed results, not paper results.
measured_claims.claim: Open results are visibly and machine-readably marked as not claimed.

open_results_not_claimed.acceptance_rule: At least one ACT or Diffusion Policy run must report both random_episode and scene_disjoint metrics, and at least one rollout report must use the same split manifest before the stronger policy-impact claim can be made.
open_results_not_claimed.boundary: No ACT, Diffusion Policy, IsaacLab, or hardware success number is claimed until policy metrics and rollout evidence are committed.
open_results_not_claimed.claim: state-of-the-art policy or physical rollout impact

high-fidelity simulator or physical rollout reports
commands.purpose: run generated ACT/Diffusion jobs in a LeRobot environment

required_artifacts: policy checkpoints or immutable checkpoint digests
train/eval configs and seeds

open_results_not_claimed.acceptance_rule: The gate must contain at least one valid rerun report with measured_inflation=true. Source-level metadata gaps alone are not score-inflation evidence.
open_results_not_claimed.boundary: The paper may call famous benchmarks unaudited with respect to USS controls, but it must not call published scores inflated until a benchmark-specific rerun passes.
open_results_not_claimed.claim: famous benchmark published scores are inflated

open_results_not_claimed.boundary: The current natural-source corpus is a scoped evidence corpus, not a prevalence estimate and not maintainer-confirmed bug evidence.

open_results_not_claimed.boundary: MuJoCo replay and URDF Studio MuJoCo/Genesis companion evidence are reported, but the same LeRobot replay trace has not yet been rerun through Genesis, Isaac, or another second WorldEpisode-native simulator adapter.
